question: Will London's high temperature reach 22°C or more on Oct 3, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the recorded high temperature in London reaches 22°C or above at any point strictly after 2026-10-02T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-03T23:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the recorded high temperature in London remains below 22°C throughout the entire period strictly after 2026-10-02T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-03T23:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- "High temperature" refers to the maximum air temperature recorded at a standard official weather observation station serving central London (e.g., Heathrow EGLL, St. James's Park, or London City Airport EGLC) during the measurement window above, expressed in degrees Celsius.
